To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the radiative corrections in the exclusive pions electroproduction below $\mathrm{Δ}(1232)$ resonance do not exceed 2 %.
the radiative corrections for the exclusive pion production below $\Delta( 1232)$ resonance do not exceed 3 % and can be described analytically with the accuracy better than 1.5 %.
radiative corrections for the single spin asymmetries in exclusive pion electro-production below the $\Delta$-resonance do not exceed 0.5 % and can be approximated by analytical expressions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of the EXCLURADCOR code for the calculation and sampling of the radiative correction for the exclusive pion photo- and electro-production.
a systematic study of the radiative effects in the pion electroproduction on the nucleon in the region below the $\Delta(1231)$ resonance.

the development of a new approach to the description of radiative corrections for analytical applications in the data analysis of the single-spin asymmetry in the $\pi^{+}$-meson electroproduction on the deuteron in the exclusive kinematics.
